title: ACM Problem-Solving Platform
description: A website designed to help users solve ACM-style competitive programming problems.

features.name: Problem Library
features.description: A comprehensive library of ACM-style problems categorized by difficulty and topic.

features.name: Code Submission and Evaluation
features.description: Allows users to submit code solutions and receive instant feedback on correctness and performance.

features.name: User Profiles
features.description: Enables users to create profiles to track their progress, solved problems, and rankings.

features.name: Leaderboard
features.description: Displays rankings of users based on their problem-solving performance.

features.name: Hints and Explanations
features.description: Provides optional hints and detailed explanations for problems to aid learning.

constraints: Requires a scalable backend for problem submissions and evaluations
target_users: Competitive programming enthusiasts, students, and professionals preparing for ACM contests.
data_requirements: Storage for user profiles, problem data, submission history, and leaderboard rankings.
